title: Wilted Middle Eastern Falafel Noodles
description: A grassy, fluffy solo-dinner dish featuring flat rice noodles and whole30-friendly falafels.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Stir in spices and cook for an additional minute.
Pour beaten eggs into the pan and stir quickly to create scrambled egg texture.
Gradually add water while continuing to stir until mixture thickens and forms a dough.
Transfer dough to a bowl and let rest at room temperature for 1 hour.
Divide dough into 8 equal pieces, roll each piece between hands into a ball shape, then flatten with the palm of your hand.
Heat oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat.
Fry falafels until golden brown on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Cook noodles according to package instructions.
